extra_context: We're a small-batch coffee roaster and cafe — I roast single-origin beans in-house a few days a week and you can smell it the second you walk in. We mostly serve regulars from the neighborhood plus folks who want good beans to brew at home, and we ship bags too. I want the place to feel warm and a little cozy, like your kitchen on a slow Sunday morning, not some sleek minimalist chain. The one thing people remember us for: every bag has a handwritten roast date and a little note about the farm the beans came from.
